verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered agent service says critical legal documents are received electronically, with phone notification for service of process. The annual-report surface shows approved documents, and the API probe notes read endpoints for registered-agent deliveries. This covers the core of digitized legal mail. The probe marker also says registered-agent endpoints were absent, and nothing describes scanning general state mail or reading, downloading, and sharing documents in the account. Missing for 10: explicit scanning of all state mail, documented in-account viewing, download, and sharing of documents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
